recent_tweets.text:
exploring ways to spin up agents from my phone

iOS shortcuts × github actions × cursor cli

world_signals: three decades of handshakes behind the glass — FastCGI still ferrying replies for reverse proxies
builders chasing identical answers out of stochastic minds — new benchmarks clock how often an LLM rhymes twice
clear april bay air, seventeen degrees holding between low clouds and dusk past eight
spring side-project quiet on GitHub — agents elsewhere doing the nightly compile
stutter-house bleeps and french indie whispers braided in the same commuting hour

composer-2-fast.concept: You are the router: swipe between three forks to shepherd glowing requests before the upstream queue corrupts.
composer-2-fast.mechanic: Lane-switch / traffic steering — wrong lanes spawn ghost duplicates that shrink your buffer.
composer-2-fast.session_hook: Each round clears a wave number; combos for clean routing feel like a flawless deploy.
composer-2-fast.escalation: Traffic density and fork speed crank up until the motorway becomes a braid.
composer-2-fast.aesthetic: Neon schematic layers over dark glass

gpt-5.5-extra-high.concept: A two-phase stutter sequencer: memorize a brief light pattern then reproduce it once the dreamy delay washes in.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.mechanic: Memory / rhythm echo — taps must mirror the echoed grid under shifting latency.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.touch_control: Tap columns in order; phase two locks to hold-and-release pulses.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.session_hook: Perfect recalls stack a euphoria meter that ruptures into color on full combo.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.escalation: Added ghost beats and fake-out pulses crowd the grid each segment.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.aesthetic: Gradient fog nightclub with prism trails

claude-opus-4-7-thinking-max.concept: Flick seed-globes downhill through a hillside fog bank; arcs must clear obstacles as spring wind bends trajectories.
claude-opus-4-7-thinking-max.mechanic: Physics flick / arc targeting — kinetic seeds that roll and rebound off terrain.
claude-opus-4-7-thinking-max.touch_control: Pull back then release sling-style from a glowing pod.
claude-opus-4-7-thinking-max.session_hook: Chain of clean landings inks a hillside meadow into bloom instantly.
claude-opus-4-7-thinking-max.escalation: Gust lines shift direction and hillside rocks fracture into smaller hazards.
claude-opus-4-7-thinking-max.aesthetic: Watercolor hillside with drifting fog bands

gemini-3.1-pro.concept: Partition a drifting tide of colored mist into side harbors — drag vertical barriers before the inlet overfills.
gemini-3.1-pro.mechanic: Sorting puzzle with sliding divider walls and rising fill timer.
gemini-3.1-pro.touch_control: Drag dividers snapped to lanes; pinch-tap to toggle mist polarity where needed.
gemini-3.1-pro.session_hook: Clear harbors sparkle; near-miss saves feel like stopping a harbor flood at dusk.
gemini-3.1-pro.escalation: New mist colors swirl in spirals requiring swap of divider mode mid-wave.
gemini-3.1-pro.aesthetic: Pastel paper harbors layered like cutout cards
